# criblio_group_system_settings (Data Source)

GroupSystemSettings DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "criblio_group_system_settings" "my_groupsystemsettings" {
  group_id = "defaultHybrid"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The hybrid worker group or edge fleet to which this instance belongs. Defaults to 'defaultHybrid'.

<a id="nestedatt--items--limits"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.limits`

Read-Only:

- `azure_blob_state_flush_interval` (Number) How often the Azure Blob state service flushes state to the central KVStore (ms).
- `bundle_download_timeout_seconds` (Number) The maximum time a Worker will wait for a successful Leader connection before canceling a download of a new configuration bundle. Default timeout is 10 minutes.
- `cpu_profile_ttl` (String) The time to live for collected CPU profiles.
- `default_heartbeat_seconds` (Number) How many seconds a managed node will wait to send back a heartbeat to the Cribl control plane.
- `disable_metrics_accessor_cache` (Boolean) Consult Cribl Support before adjusting this advanced setting. Disable the metrics accessor cache.
- `edge_metrics_custom_expression` (String) JavaScript expression to filter metrics.
- `edge_metrics_mode` (String) Choose a set of metrics for Edge Nodes to send to the Leader, or define a custom set.
- `edge_nodes_count` (Number) Used to pre-allocate connection handlers. Changing this value could restart currently running connection handlers, causing all Edge Nodes to reconnect.
- `enable_metrics_persistence` (Boolean) Disable to stop writing metrics to disk.
- `enable_process_info_using_windows_tools` (Boolean) Enable PowerShell to collect process information instead of using the native API.
- `enable_worker_in_memory` (Boolean) Do not persist connection data across restarts. Caution: Leader will restart when this setting is changed.
- `events_metadata_sources` (List of String) List of event metadata sources to enable.
- `hb_connection_mode` (String) Persistent: connection stays open. Ephemeral: connection can disconnect after a configured duration. Auto: treated as persistent in this version.
- `hb_metric_spool_max_file_size` (String) Maximum file size per slice in the heartbeat metric spool. Active only in ephemeral mode.
- `hb_metric_spool_max_size` (String) Maximum disk size for the heartbeat metric spool persistent queue. In ephemeral mode, 0 disables disk persistence and buffers metrics in RAM only.
- `hb_offline_duration` (String) Time before marking node offline. Format: number plus unit (s, m, h, or d), e.g. 60s, 5m, 1h. Unitless values are treated as seconds. Minimum 2m.
- `kv_store_enable_wal` (Boolean) Enable the write-ahead log for the KVStore.
- `kv_store_service_period` (Number) How often the KVStore syncs itself to disk. When WAL mode is enabled, deltas to the KVStore are synced to disk immediately as they happen; however, the WAL is merged back into the overall KVStore on this interval.
- `kv_store_wal_max_bytes` (Number) The amount of bytes to allow a WAL file to get to before committing the WAL back into the KVStore.
- `large_events_threshold` (String) Deprecated. Large events are now tracked using a histogram with fixed buckets.
- `lookup_allowed_paths` (List of String) Additional directories where lookup files are permitted to reside, beyond the default lookup directories under CRIBL_HOME. Use this allowlist to keep lookups on a shared mount or another location outside CRIBL_HOME. Each entry is a directory path; environment variables such as <code>$CRIBL_HOME</code> are expanded, and relative entries resolve against CRIBL_HOME. A lookup file is permitted when it resides within any listed directory. Leaving this empty restricts lookups to the default lookup directories.
- `lookup_max_size` (String) Maximum allowed disk space for persisting single lookup data file.
- `lookup_max_total_size` (String) Maximum allowed disk space for persisting lookup data and metadata files.
- `max_dimension_value_size` (Number) Maximum allowed length, in characters, for a metric dimension value. Metric series with a dimension value exceeding this limit are dropped.
- `max_eps` (Number) Maximum number of event processors (EPs) that all sources can create collectively within a worker process. When this limit is reached, new connections or requests are rejected to limit worker resources. Set to 0 to disable the limit.
- `max_event_bytes_mode` (String) Consult Cribl Support before adjusting this advanced setting. How the event breaker handles a segment that exceeds maxEventBytes with no break boundary: 'drop' emits the bounded head and discards the remainder through the next boundary; 'split' preserves every byte as bounded fragments.
- `max_metrics` (Number) The system's total allowed number of metric series. Consult Cribl Support before updating this value.
- `max_pq_size` (String) Highest accepted value for individual integrations' persistent queue 'Max queue size' parameters. Consult Cribl Support before increasing the default 1 TB.
- `max_pipelines_per_pack` (Number) Maximum number of pipelines allowed in a single Pack. Packs above this limit are rejected at install time, because loading very large Packs can exhaust a worker group's config helper memory. Consult Cribl Support before updating this value.
- `max_reconnect_interval` (String) The maximum time to wait before attempting to reconnect to the Leader after being disconnected.
- `metrics_directory` (String) Directory to store metrics on disk.
- `metrics_drop_list` (List of String) List of metric names to drop. Supports wildcards.
- `metrics_fields_blacklist` (List of String) List of event fields for which to disable metric collection.
- `metrics_gc_period` (String) The interval at which the system attempts to free memory by pruning stale metrics from the Stream system metrics store.
- `metrics_max_cardinality` (Number) The system's allowed number of permutations of a given metric name.
- `metrics_max_disk_space` (String) Maximum allowed disk space for persisting metrics to disk.
- `metrics_never_drop_list` (List of String) List metric names for which to ensure delivery. Supports wildcards.
- `metrics_worker_id_blacklist` (List of String) List of metric names for which to disable tracking of Worker Node ID. Supports wildcards.
- `min_free_space` (String) The minimum amount of disk space in the system before various features will take measures to prevent disk usage (KB, MB, etc.).
- `min_reconnect_interval` (String) The minimum time to wait before attempting to reconnect to the Leader after being disconnected. The interval is doubled with each failed reconnect attempt until the maximum limit is reached.
- `net_flow_template_flush_interval` (Number) Consult Cribl Support before adjusting this advanced setting. It determines how often the NetFlow template service sends templates to the central KVStore.
- `random_reconnect_interval` (String) Maximum random delay added to every connection or reconnect attempt — including the initial connection, error-backoff retries, and ephemeral-mode offline cycles. Set to a non-zero value to stagger simultaneous connection attempts across a large Fleet and avoid spiking the leader with too many attempts (aka thundering herd problem).
- `rate_limit_bytes_per_second` (String) Consult Cribl Support before adjusting this advanced setting. The maximum number of bytes per second that a worker is allowed to ingest. If 0 or not configured, no rate limiting is applied. A value of 'auto' means the limit is determined automatically based on configurations.
- `samples` (Attributes) Samples configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--limits--samples))
- `worker_max_metrics` (Number) The maximum number of metric series allowed per worker. Consult Cribl Support before updating this value.
